content: If the referenced NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT, the function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall only set the request result NvM_RequestResultType to NVM_REQ_OK when b oth NV blocks have been invalidated.

If the referenced NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT, the function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall only set the request result NvM_RequestResultType to NVM_REQ_OK when both NV blocks have been i nvalidated.

If the referenced NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_RE- DUNDANT, the function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall only set the request result NvM_ RequestResultType to NVM_REQ_OK when both NV blocks have been invalidated.

If the referenced NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_RE- DUNDANT, the function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall only set the request result NvM_ RequestResultType to NVM_REQ_OK when both NV blocks have been invalidated.
